name: api-types
description: 서버 OpenAPI에서 자동 생성한 TS 타입. 손으로 고치지 않는다 (ADR-013)

scripts.openapi: cd ../../apps/server && uv run python -c "import json; from api.main import app; print(json.dumps(app.openapi(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))" > ../../packages/api-types/openapi.json
scripts.generate: pnpm run openapi && openapi-typescript openapi.json -o index.ts
